faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the District Legal Services Authority Koraput, also known as DLSA Koraput, based in the state of Odisha for selecting eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in this notification?
faq.answer: The post offered in this recruitment notification is Para Legal Volunteer (PLV) under notification number NOTIFICATION NO-01(A) issued for the district of Koraput.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 14-10-2026. Candidates must ensure that their applications reach the designated authority before 05:00 PM on this date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for DLSA Koraput Recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Candidates are required to send their applications through speed post, courier, or by hand to the specified official address.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the PLV post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be literate, with a preference for matriculation or intermediate qualification, along with a capacity for overall comprehension and must be residents of Koraput District.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for applying to this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification released by the District Legal Services Authority Koraput for the Para Legal Volunteer positions.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary or remuneration for Para Legal Volunteers?
faq.answer: There is no fixed salary, remuneration, or regular wages. However, volunteers receive an honorarium on specific assignments as fixed by the D.L.S.A. or T.L.S.Cs from time to time.

faq.question: Q8. To whom should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: The completed application form must be addressed to the Secretary D.L.S.A., Koraput-Jayapur, A.D.R. Building, Inside District Court Premises Jayapur, Pin: 764001 via speed post, courier, or hand delivery.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for DLSA Koraput PLV recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves screening of the received offline applications followed by formal enrollment of the eligible candidates by the District Legal Services Authority.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates get the official notification and details?
faq.answer: Candidates can refer to the official notification published by DLSA Koraput or check the important links section in this article to access the notification details and application instructions.
